title: Chance Designs
identity: Chance Designs is Randall Snyder’s 2011 trio for tenor saxophone, trombone and vibraphone, dedicated to Spencer Nielson. The local public score is explicitly labeled transposed score; opening and second system were visually inspected.

evidence.claim: University of Nebraska-Lincoln SelectedWorks score states instrumentation, dedication and 2011 date.
University repository composition item identifies the same score and instrumentation.

score_observations.claim: The opening and following system alternate 4/4, 3/4 and 2/4 bars; the tenor saxophone part uses frequent chromatic alterations, beamed figures and dynamic changes. The score labels the saxophone “transposed score.”
score_observations.source: University of Nebraska-Lincoln public score, pp. 1-2.

review_focus: Inference: inspect rhythmic coordination across changing meters and the score’s written transposition before assessing ensemble fluency.
collection_flag: Original contemporary chamber work for tenor saxophone, trombone and vibraphone.

score_links.description: Local score file; title page and notation on pp.1-2 visually inspected.

gaps: No performance recording or college program located.
